overview_para1: The School of Bible Studies exists to help believers of every stage grow in the knowledge and understanding of God's Word. Through structured courses taught by experienced instructors, students explore Scripture in depth, wrestle with its meaning, and learn to apply it to everyday life.
overview_para2: Whether you're new to the faith or have walked with the Lord for years, our courses are designed to challenge and encourage you as you build a stronger foundation in Christ.
course1_desc: An introductory course covering the core beliefs of the Christian faith, ideal for new believers or anyone wanting a refresher on the basics.
course2_desc: A journey through the Old Testament, tracing God's covenant story from creation through the prophets.
course3_desc: An in-depth look at the Gospels, the early church, and the epistles, exploring the life and teachings of Jesus and the apostles.
course4_desc: A practical course on applying biblical principles to relationships, work, finances, and daily discipleship.
step1_desc: Review the course offerings above and decide which one fits where you are in your walk with God.
step2_desc: Fill out the enrollment form below with your information and course of interest.
step3_desc: Our team will follow up with class details, materials, and everything you need to get started.
